nodes.title: Northwind People — Hybrid work policy (BE, 2023)
nodes.body: Invented rule: Belgium-based staff may work remotely up to 2 days per week.

nodes.title: Northwind People — Hybrid work policy (BE, 2025)
nodes.body: Invented rule: Belgium-based staff may work remotely up to 3 days per week. This document replaces the 2023 version.

nodes.title: Teams — #belgium-office: “unlimited remote is fine now”
nodes.body: Invented chat: “Ignore the PDF, we all do unlimited WFH now.”

nodes.title: Northwind People — Hybrid work policy (NL, 2024)
nodes.body: Invented rule: Netherlands-based staff may work remotely up to 4 days per week.

nodes.title: Internal wiki: hybrid days (unsigned page)
nodes.body: Invented wiki stub with no owner. Still says 2 remote days per week.

nodes.title: Email from Sam (HR) — “stay on 2 days until Q4”
nodes.body: Invented email: “Please keep Belgium at 2 remote days until Q4; the 2025 PDF is being reviewed.”
